user.title: Connect to FLEETA
user.description:
Three quick steps:

1. Open the [FLEETA web viewer]({viewer_url}) and sign in.
2. Go to **Management**, then **Open API**, then the **API keys** tab, and issue a key.
3. Copy the key and paste it below.

data_description.api_key: Starts with flt_live_. It is stored in Home Assistant only.

reauth_confirm.title: FLEETA API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: The FLEETA API key was rejected. It may have been revoked. Issue a new key in the [FLEETA web viewer]({viewer_url}) under **Management**, **Open API**, **API keys**, and paste it below.

data_description.api_key: Starts with flt_live_. It is stored in Home Assistant only.

error.invalid_key_format: That doesn't look like a FLEETA API key. Keys start with flt_.
error.plan_not_supported: This FLEETA plan doesn't include GPS access through the API.
error.rate_limited: FLEETA's API call limit has been reached. Try again later.

init.title: FLEETA update rate
init.description: By default updates are paced automatically so the monthly API allowance is never used up: faster while driving, slower while parked.

data.scan_interval_minutes: Never check more often than every (minutes)

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: 0 = automatic. A higher number saves API calls. It can only slow updates down, never speed them past the allowance.

monthly_limit.message: FLEETA's monthly API allowance is used up. Updates resume when it resets on the 1st.

rate_limited.message: FLEETA asked for fewer requests. Retrying at the next update.
